title: How We Got it Toupee Off | S2E21 "Something Borrowed"

sentences.zh: 大家好，我是杰夫·米查姆。

sentences.en: I played the wedding DJ in the season three finale.
sentences.zh: 我在第三季大结局中饰演了婚礼DJ。

sentences.en: I had just moved to Los Angeles.
It was the second job I ever booked out in LA.
sentences.zh: 这是我在洛杉矶接到的第二份工作。

sentences.en: First comedy I had booked, first multicam.
sentences.zh: 我接的第一部喜剧，第一部多机位拍摄。

sentences.en: And as soon as I got onto set, I was like, oh, this is what I want to do for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 一到片场我就想，哦，这就是我想干一辈子的工作。
言归正传，我们来到了片场。

sentences.en: There's all sorts of moving parts.
And I'm up in the kind of a bird's eye view in the DJ booth.
sentences.zh: 我在DJ台上有种上帝视角的感觉。

sentences.en: And boom, first team comes in.
sentences.zh: 然后砰的一声，A组演员进场了。

sentences.en: And you guys are all carrying your coffees and your sides and your cracking jokes and having the best time together.
sentences.zh: 你们都拿着咖啡、剧本，开着玩笑，在一起玩得超级开心。

sentences.en: And Pam comes in and kind of orchestrates the whole scene.
sentences.zh: 帕姆进来统筹了整个场景。

sentences.en: Neil's character comes and stands next to me.
sentences.zh: 尼尔的角色走过来站到了我旁边。

sentences.en: And someone just yells the word, second team.
sentences.zh: 接着有人大喊了一声：B组。

sentences.en: And you guys just kind of funnel off together, leave, grab your coffees, and you're giggling as you're leaving.
sentences.zh: 然后你们就一起离开，去拿咖啡，离开时还在咯咯笑。

sentences.en: And in comes this group of people that kind of look like you wearing chalkboards with your characters' names on them.
sentences.zh: 接着进来了一群长得有点像你们的人，他们身上挂着写有你们角色名字的小黑板。

sentences.en: And I was like, what is this?
And somebody comes over and they're like, oh, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 然后有人走过来对我说，哦，对，对。
他们基本上就是进来排练，

sentences.en: and then they leave and they get to go have the best time of their lives while these people come in and do all the blocking and get everything set with the lights.
sentences.zh: 然后离开，去过他们最开心的生活，而这些人进来帮我们走位并调好灯光。

sentences.en: And then they come back in, tell jokes, and be stars.
sentences.zh: 然后他们再回来，讲讲笑话，当大明星。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, that's what I want to do for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，哦，这就是我想干一辈子的工作。

sentences.en: So that really was a big turning point in my life where I was like, oh, this is amazing.
sentences.zh: 所以那真的是我人生的一个重大转折点，当时我就觉得，哦，这太棒了。

sentences.en: I remember how kind Pam was.
In fact, I just got to work with her again recently.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我最近又刚和她合作过。

sentences.en: And how cool it was as this young 20-something where Neil comes over and stands next to me.
sentences.zh: 作为一个二十多岁的年轻小伙，当尼尔走过来站在我旁边时，那种感觉太酷了。

sentences.en: And I was like, hey, man, I grew up watching you.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，嘿，兄弟，我是看着你的戏长大的。

sentences.en: do you remember on Law & Order a couple years ago where you played that kind of psycho killer guy where you lobotomize women by pouring hot water into their brains?
sentences.zh: 你还记得几年前在《法律与秩序》里，你演过那个精神病杀手吗，就是那种把热水倒进女人的大脑里给她们做脑叶切除术的那个？

sentences.en: And I was like, my wife was that woman.
sentences.zh: 我说，我老婆就是那个女人。
能参演这部伟大的剧真是太棒了。

sentences.en: You guys were the beSt. And I can't thank you enough for that experience.
sentences.zh: 你们是最棒的。我万分感谢你们带给我的这段经历。

sentences.en: What a great note to start the show with.
And what a voice he has.
I hope he has his own podcast, right?
sentences.zh: 我希望他有自己的播客，对吧？

sentences.en: Alec has done podcasts with Jeff, right?
sentences.zh: 亚历克和杰夫一起做过播客，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes, Jeff and I have a podcaSt. It's Meeting Tom Cruise.
sentences.zh: 对，杰夫和我有个播客节目，叫《遇见汤姆·克鲁斯》。

sentences.en: You can go listen to that, too.
I didn't know that, like, that little bit you did, being in that one episode, this episode, Something Borrowed, meant so much to you and was such an early part of your journey.
sentences.zh: 我之前不知道，你客串的那一集——也就是这一集《借来的幸福》，对你意义这么重大，而且是你演艺生涯早期的重要经历。

sentences.en: That's one of the many things, like, you don't know.
sentences.zh: 很多事情就是这样，你当时并不了解。

sentences.en: You don't know what it means in the moment.
sentences.zh: 你当时并不知道它意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's good to, when you're starting out in a business as crazy and unpredictable as the one we're in, it's really good to have good early formative experiences.
sentences.zh: 当你刚踏入我们这个疯狂且不可预测的行业时，能有几个早期良好的奠基体验，真的是件大好事。

sentences.en: It's a working set where people are happy.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大家都开开心心的片场。

sentences.en: So we're glad we were able to provide you with that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们很高兴能为你提供这样的经历。
并不是所有片场都这样。

sentences.en: Not every set is like that.
sentences.zh: 不是每个剧组都那么融洽。

sentences.en: Well, we're thrilled you could join us.
And we're thrilled you, who are listening to this, could join us here today for another episode of How We Made Your Mother,
sentences.zh: 也欢迎正在收听节目的各位，今天加入我们的又一期《我们是如何创造你母亲的》，

sentences.en: where Craig Thomas and I talk about the TV show we made together, How I Met Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 在这个节目里，克雷格·托马斯和我将讨论我们共同制作的电视剧《老爸老妈浪漫史》。

sentences.en: I played Ted Mosby on that show from 2005 to 2014.
sentences.zh: 我在2005年到2014年期间在该剧中饰演泰德·莫斯比。

sentences.en: Craig and his buddy Carter Bays co-created the show.
sentences.zh: 克雷格和他的好搭档卡特·贝斯共同创作了这部剧。

sentences.en: We did 208 episodes of the show, and we are barreling through watching them all again, and we're coming to the end of season two.
sentences.zh: 我们一共拍了208集，现在正马不停蹄地重温它们，马上就要看完第二季了。

sentences.en: Today we're talking about episode 21, Something Borrowed, written by Greg Malins, one of our faves who was on the show a couple episodes ago this season.
sentences.zh: 今天我们要讨论的是第21集《借来的幸福》，由格雷格·马林斯编剧，他是我们最喜欢的编剧之一，本季前几集还来过我们的节目。

sentences.en: And, Alec, tell us, historically, root us, when did this episode air?
sentences.zh: 那么，亚历克，给我们讲讲，从历史的角度，锁定一下，这一集是什么时候播出的？

sentences.en: Yeah, cast your mind back to May 7th, 2007.
sentences.zh: 好的，把思绪拉回到2007年5月7日。

sentences.en: It's a TV wedding, so it happened in May sweeps.
sentences.zh: 这是一场电视剧里的婚礼，所以它正好赶上了5月的收视率大战。
我们本来就能猜到是5月。

sentences.en: May would have been the topmost guess.
That would have been number one on the Family Feud guesses.
sentences.zh: 那在《家庭问答》的民调里绝对能排第一。

sentences.en: This begins, this is kind of part one of a two-parter.
sentences.zh: 故事从这开始，这可以说是两集连播的上集。

sentences.en: And Josh actually said earlier today, like, it's kind of part two of a three-parter,
sentences.zh: 乔希今天早些时候甚至说过，这其实可以算是一个三部曲的第二部分，

sentences.en: because it feels like the episode Showdown that precedes this has a few little nuggets planted in it about the wedding.
sentences.zh: 因为在这之前的《摊牌》那一集里，似乎就埋下了关于这场婚礼的一些小彩蛋。

sentences.en: And you actually get a little glimpse of this wedding.
sentences.zh: 而且你甚至能提前瞥见这场婚礼的一角。

sentences.en: Marshall's in a hat in the wedding, very mysteriously.
sentences.zh: 马歇尔在婚礼上戴着一顶帽子，非常神秘。

sentences.en: Marshall's in a hat, which is great.
sentences.zh: 马歇尔戴着帽子，太棒了。

sentences.en: It led Jordana to say, why is Marshall wearing a hat?
sentences.zh: 这让乔丹娜忍不住问：马歇尔为什么戴着帽子？
还戴着那种奇怪的帽子。

sentences.en: And you go, wait for it.
sentences.zh: 然后你会说，拭目以待吧。

sentences.en: And also, isn't Showdown where Ted and Robin come in in their spaghetti-stained clothes?
sentences.zh: 另外，泰德和罗宾穿着沾满意大利面的衣服出场，是不是就在《决战时刻》那一集？

sentences.en: They come in and they're covered in spaghetti sauce, and they say, we'll tell you that later.
sentences.zh: 他们走进来时身上沾满了意大利面酱，然后说，我们回头再告诉你们。

sentences.en: And they mean much later, because you don't find out until the episode after this.
sentences.zh: 而且他们说的“回头”是真的很久以后，因为你要到下一集才能知道原因。

sentences.en: But that's why these three feel like a three-part finale, in a way, of the season.
sentences.zh: 但这也是为什么这三集在某种程度上让人感觉像是这一季的三部分大结局。
对，再说一次，这就是悬念。
这是穿插在其中的一个个小悬念。

sentences.en: But it also shows to me that you guys were really mapping this thing out.
sentences.zh: 但这也向我证明，你们当时确实在精心规划这一切。

sentences.en: And you were really, you wanted everything to count.
sentences.zh: 而且你们真的很用心，想让每一个细节都有意义。

sentences.en: You know, sometimes there's dangling threads, or people comment and say, why did this happen?
sentences.zh: 你知道，有时候会有一些悬而未决的线索，或者观众会评论说，为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Because in episode, you know, season seven, this happened.
sentences.zh: 因为在你知道的第七季里，发生过这种事。

sentences.en: And you couldn't account for everything.
sentences.zh: 而你们不可能事事都面面俱到。

sentences.en: But I think you guys did an amazing job tying things up.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你们在收尾方面做得非常出色。

sentences.en: I was very excited, because my wife hadn't seen this one in a long time.
sentences.zh: 我当时很兴奋，因为我太太很久没看过这一集了。

sentences.en: And I said, do you, well, I guess it was in Showdown, I said this.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，你……哦，我想我是在《决战时刻》里说过这个。

sentences.en: I said, do you remember why they're covered in pasta sauce?
sentences.zh: 我说，你还记得他们为什么浑身沾满面酱吗？

sentences.en: It didn't register for her at all.
And she was like, she didn't think it was weird.
sentences.zh: 而且她当时觉得，这也没什么奇怪的。

sentences.en: It just kind of goes by.
sentences.zh: 剧情就这样一晃而过了。

sentences.en: And then, like, when we watched, we watched the, spoilers, we watched the one we'll talk about after this, which is something blue, the finale of season two.
sentences.zh: 然后呢，当我们看——剧透一下，我们看了接下来要聊的那集，也就是第二季大结局《蔚蓝之谜》。

sentences.en: And she was very excited, because she was like, that's the pasta sauce.
sentences.zh: 她非常兴奋，因为她说，原来那是面酱啊。

sentences.en: And I had actual pasta sauce spilled onto me.
sentences.zh: 而且我自己身上还真被洒过意大利面酱。

sentences.en: You're the person who should have had the strongest visceral memory.
sentences.zh: 你才是最应该有深刻切身体会的人。

sentences.en: Well, I, yeah, I mean, I think that that speaks to, like, Carter is a crossword puzzle guy, like me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我，对，我是说，我觉得这说明了，卡特和我有一样的地方，他是个填字游戏迷。

sentences.en: But I think you both have a sense of, like, puzzlemanship.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得你们两个都有那种，怎么说呢，解谜的天赋。

sentences.en: You heard it here first, ladies and gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，你们在这里头一次听到这个词。

sentences.en: You like things kind of falling into place.
sentences.zh: 你们喜欢各种线索各就各位的感觉。

sentences.en: You like, you like a good mislead.
sentences.zh: 你们喜欢，你们喜欢精彩的误导。

sentences.en: You like, what is going on?
sentences.zh: 你们喜欢那种“到底是怎么回事”的感觉？

sentences.en: Let's show how we got there.
sentences.zh: 让我们展示一下我们是怎么走到这一步的。

sentences.en: We love telling stories like that.
sentences.zh: 我们很喜欢讲这样的故事。

sentences.en: We looked at these seasons kind of like novels, kind of like you could jump around, and really everything should refer to something else.
sentences.zh: 我们把这些季当成小说来看，你可以跳着看，而且确实每件事都应该与其他事情呼应。

sentences.en: Everything should be there for a reason, if it possibly can be.
sentences.zh: 如果可能的话，每个细节存在都应该有它的理由。

sentences.en: And we really looked at a season as one big organism, rather than this series of standalone things.
sentences.zh: 而且我们真的把一整季看作是一个庞大的有机体，而不是一系列独立的东西。

sentences.en: Which, like we said at the beginning of season two, the network would have probably been happier at the time if we had done standalone episodes that were very digestible,
sentences.zh: 就像我们在第二季开始时所说的，如果我们当时拍那种非常容易消化、各自独立的剧集，电视台可能当时会更高兴，
那种不需要动太多脑子的。

sentences.en: You don't have to have seen them in any particular order.
sentences.zh: 你不需要按任何特定的顺序去观看它们。

sentences.en: It's just not how we write.
sentences.zh: 但这根本不是我们的写作方式。

sentences.en: They asked us to do more of that, and we kind of said, we'll try, knowing that we were not going to try and that we can't.
sentences.zh: 他们要求我们多拍那种剧，而我们当时说，我们会试试的，其实心里知道我们根本不会去试，也做不到。

sentences.en: We could only write it this way.
And I have to say, rewatching it feels very vindicating for that decision because it's very fun to watch like this again, right?
sentences.zh: 我必须说，重温它让我觉得当初的决定得到了极大的证明，因为这样重新看一遍真的很有趣，对吧？

sentences.en: It's very fun to go back and go, this is why everything was here.
sentences.zh: 回头去看然后说“这就是为什么一切都在这里”，这真的很有意思。

sentences.en: But I think the sense of payoff that is tied to the longevity and serialized nature of the show is why people keep coming back to the show, like it's some sort of holy shrine,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，与这部剧的长寿和连贯的剧集性质紧密相连的这种回报感，正是人们不断回到这部剧的原因，把它当成某种神圣的圣地一样，

sentences.en: because it rewards your fidelity to it.
sentences.zh: 因为它回报了你对它的忠诚。

sentences.en: Like the more you watch it, it's like a mystery.
sentences.zh: 就像你看得越多，它就越像一个谜团。

sentences.en: I know what that clue is going to be.
sentences.zh: 我知道那个线索会是什么。

sentences.en: I know what the payoff is going to be to that clue, and people like that.
sentences.zh: 我知道那个线索会带来什么样的回报，人们很喜欢这样。

sentences.en: There's a thing, I think this is from the Bhagavad Gita, forgive me if it's not, but there's some line, essentially, from like Vedic something, where it says,
sentences.zh: 有一句话，我想这是出自《薄伽梵歌》，如果不是的话请原谅我，但基本上是来自某种吠陀经典的话，上面说，

sentences.en: the first taste of ego is sweet, but its fruits are bitter.
sentences.zh: 对自我的最初品尝是甜的，但它的果实是苦的。

sentences.en: And the first taste of God is bitter, but its fruits are sweet.
sentences.zh: 而对神的最初品尝是苦的，但它的果实是甜的。

sentences.en: And I feel like what the network was saying was like, give us fruit, sweet, sweet, sweet.
sentences.zh: 我觉得电视台当时的意思就像是，给我们果实吧，要甜的，甜的，甜的。

sentences.en: And then it curdles over time because it's too easy.
sentences.zh: 然后随着时间的推移，它变味了，因为这太容易得到了。

sentences.en: But what you guys were saying was like, we're going to give you something a little more challenging that will ultimately down the line be more rewarding for you.
sentences.zh: 但你们当时的意思是，我们要给你们一些更有挑战性的东西，从长远来看，这最终会对你们更有回报。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's kind of the ultimate wait for it.
sentences.zh: 对，这可以说是终极的“拭目以待”。

sentences.en: Wait for it is kind of the mantra of the series.
sentences.zh: “拭目以待”可以说是这部剧的座右铭。

sentences.en: Wait for it is the whole mantra.
That is the guiding aesthetic of the whole series.
sentences.zh: 那是整个剧集的核心美学。

sentences.en: And the last line of this season.
sentences.zh: 也是这一季的最后一台词。

sentences.en: We'll get there in the next one.
sentences.zh: 我们会在下一集中讲到那里。

sentences.en: But that is one of my, maybe my favorite ending of a season we ever did is the ending of this season.
sentences.zh: 但那是我的，也许是我最喜欢的我们做过的某一季的结尾，就是这一季的结尾。

sentences.en: But here we are in a second to last episode.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们来到了倒数第二集。

sentences.en: I just realized my voice is sound.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚意识到我的声音听起来……

sentences.en: I just want to say that I've had this upper respiratory infection for the last couple days.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，我过去几天一直有上呼吸道感染。

sentences.en: I'm getting through it and it hasn't been fun.
sentences.zh: 我在挺过去，但这过程可不好受。

sentences.en: But I'm well enough to be here today and I'm thrilled to be here today.
sentences.zh: 但我现在身体好多了，今天能来到这里，而且我非常高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: I was really, I was really taken.
sentences.zh: 我真的，我真的被深深打动了。

sentences.en: My wife and I watched the last three episodes all last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我和我妻子连着看完了最后三集。

sentences.en: I want to tell you this.
It was during the third, it was during Something Blue.
sentences.zh: 那是第三季期间，那是拍《Something Blue》的时候。

sentences.en: And it reminded me of, do you know the actor Victor Garber?
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一个人，你知道演员维克多·加博吗？

sentences.en: He played the ship's architect in Titanic.
sentences.zh: 他在《泰坦尼克号》里演了造船师。

sentences.en: And he just had a long, great career.
sentences.zh: 他一直有着漫长而辉煌的演艺生涯。
就像特德一样，又一个经典的建筑师。

sentences.en: And we did this musical together years ago called She Loves Me.
sentences.zh: 多年前我们一起合作过一部音乐剧叫《爱我》。

sentences.en: And we had a great experience.
sentences.zh: 我们有过很棒的合作经历。

sentences.en: And so we had a lot of time to chat.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有很多时间聊天。

sentences.en: And he was in the original cast of Sweeney Todd, the great Stephen Sondheim musical.
sentences.zh: 他曾是《理发师陶德》原版卡司的一员，那是伟大的斯蒂芬·桑德海姆的音乐剧。

sentences.en: And he played the young ingenue.
sentences.zh: 他当时演那个年轻的纯真角色。

sentences.en: He sings that great song, Joanna.
sentences.zh: 他唱了那首经典的歌《乔安娜》。

sentences.en: And he said they opened the show and he got an offer to do,
sentences.zh: 他说当时剧目刚上演，他就接到一个邀约，

sentences.en: I think this musical called They're Playing Our Song, which is a two-hander musical.
sentences.zh: 我想那是一部叫《他们在演奏我们的歌》的音乐剧，是一部双人音乐剧。

sentences.en: He got an offer to go on the road for a lot of money with a big star.
sentences.zh: 他收到了一份巡演邀请，能和一位大明星一起赚很多钱。

sentences.en: He left Sweeney Todd to go do this.
